title: Flying fireflies
description: Adds flying fireflies to the game's main menu and color settings for them
body:

**Flying FireFlies**

This mod adds flying fireflies to the main menu, as well as the ability to enable them in the player's inventory (press Ctrl + M to open the menu in-game). A button for configuring the mod will appear in the top right of the menu. You can choose any color from it by copying (HEX) the color, which you can find online. There are also options for speed, quantity, and rainbow display of the fireflies. If you manage to click on it, it will disappear and appear somewhere else.
